subject.title: fix(exec-approval): distinguish non-persistable command from ask=always policy in approval prompt

question: Should maintainers repair this focused PR into the canonical fix for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/97069, or promote a broader sibling PR after mergeability and proof are verified?
rationale: Multiple open PRs target the same bug, and this branch still has concrete renderer defects plus a contributor proof gate, so automation should not choose the canonical landing path.

options.title: Repair this PR before merge
options.body: Keep this PR open, fix the remaining forwarding/native renderer issues, require real prompt proof, and then use it as the canonical branch if maintainers prefer the smaller diff.

options.title: Promote a sibling canonical fix
options.body: Use an overlapping PR only if it is updated against current main, mergeable, full-surface, and proof-positive, then close this branch after that path is selected or merged.

options.title: Pause duplicate branches
options.body: Hold the duplicate branches until an approval-area owner records the final implementation shape.

recommendation.title: Repair this PR before merge
recommendation.body: Keep this PR open, fix the remaining forwarding/native renderer issues, require real prompt proof, and then use it as the canonical branch if maintainers prefer the smaller diff.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining decision is mostly about approval renderer ownership and native approval lifecycle coverage.
